finding: The default constructor crops, reorients and recolours a single canonical 20x20 bitmap. This reproduces the supplied task, but does not supply new underlying pictures for mechanism-generalization training.
evidence: The _ROWS constant stores the canonical output drawing.
_base and _ORIENTATIONS always derive from that constant.
generate varies only window bounds, D4 orientation and two-colour palette.
required_followup: Generate a fresh structured binary picture as an episode-level latent template.
Use that same template for all three demonstrations and the query; vary crops, orientation and colours with unique-placement checks.
Keep canonical reconstruction separate and labelled.
Add a contextual verifier based on the episode template; the fixed-template archived solver cannot validate new pictures.
Add episode-level generator support to the builder before registration; never combine independent-template pairs into one episode.
